explanations: live() runs the critical dependency checks, so when Postgres is down (or slow enough to time out) every pod fails its liveness probe at the same moment and Kubernetes restarts them all. A restart can't fix a dependency outage. It only adds cold starts and connection storms just as the database comes back. Liveness should answer only "is this process itself broken?" (here, the fatal flag) and must not call dependencies. Readiness already takes the instance out of the load balancer while the database is down. The fix makes live() return ok unless markFatal was called.
